body.statement: Is the obstruction branch \(O\) impossible at every legal source-factorized cyclic terminal reached by the deterministic recursion, and does every satisfiable two-copy separator returned by \(\mathsf{SATerm}\) admit the boundary-interface transmission required to decode two same-alphabet models with the original source incidence? Equivalently, can comprehensive componentwise function-field descent always produce one rational circuit when the uniform two-copy separator formula is unsatisfiable, while every satisfiable formula survives recursive gluing?
body.justification: Constancy on real semialgebraic source fibers need not automatically descend to one rational function, and local separation can vanish after attachment.
body.gap: LeeSpekkens2017 gives rational recovery in selected small structures and NavascuesWolfe2020 gives asymptotically complete compatibility, but neither proves rational descent with finite same-class separators and cyclic interfaces.
body.consumer: A positive answer completes SC-CTFID; a concrete obstruction identifies the necessary enlargement of its output language.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove that positive-real fiber constancy on every legal source-factorized terminal forces one rational representative with a divisor nonzero on the entire positive feasible image, and prove that every local separator can be chosen with nonzero transmission through every stored recursive interface.
obligation.obstruction: Real semialgebraic fiber constancy alone does not generally imply rational function-field membership, and the frozen recursion invariant does not establish that a boundary factor multiplying local separation is nonzero. The terminal explicitly contains an obstruction output for the first failure, while the gluing lemma assumes rather than constructs a transmitting assignment for the second.
obligation.attempted: Reduced the problem componentwise by comprehensive elimination; proved exact rational descent for the latent-path product terminal and the unrestricted binary two-cycle; derived the full primitive-event gluing identity; checked a source-preserving two-district transmitter; and rejected legality-only gluing with an exact CHSH witness. None of these arguments proves normality or rational closure of every projected source variety, nor a universal noncancellation invariant.
obligation.partial_result:
The following parts are closed.  On every explicit terminal, real quantifier elimination decides the two-copy formula and, when it is satisfiable, supplies algebraic source-simplex points with identical menu and interface polynomials and a nonzero target cross-product.  When it is unsatisfiable, \(H/K\) is set-theoretically constant on every positive real fiber.  On any comprehensive component on which \(H/K\in\mathbb Q(p)\), exact function-field membership produces a rational representative, and quantifier elimination verifies both its identity and its nonvanishing divisor.  The three-node latent-path terminal is a complete positive example: \(T_1\perp T_3\) is necessary and sufficient, and its four mixed-alphabet targets equal \(u_av_b\).  The binary shared-source two-cycle is the convex special case in which row-space separation supplies rational witnesses.  The boundary-interface lemma proves global preservation whenever a certificate contains a nonzero transmitting assignment, and the explicit two-district construction transmits \(1/3\) to \(3/8\) while preserving all \(81\) intervention laws.

For that binary terminal, let \(A_M\) contain a normalization row and every complete cell row supplied by menu \(M\), and let \(h,g\) be numerator and denominator event rows.  On the relative interior of the twelve-profile simplex, constancy of \((h\pi)/(g\pi)\) along every \(v\in\ker A_M\) implies
\[
 (hv)(g\pi)-(gv)(h\pi)=0.
\]
If \(h\) and \(g\) are linearly independent, varying \(\pi\) over an open set forces \(hv=gv=0\), so \(h,g\in\operatorname{row}(A_M)\); if they are dependent, the ratio is constant.  Conversely either condition gives an immediate rational formula.  When neither holds, choose a rational \(v\in\ker A_M\) for which the displayed derivative is nonzero at a positive rational \(\pi\); a sufficiently small rational \(\epsilon\ne0\) makes \(\pi+\epsilon v\) positive, preserves the menu, and changes the ratio.  Exact enumeration of the \(2^5=32\) subsets of the observational and four single-clamp regimes, the \(54\) event rows formed by conjunctions of at most two coordinate assignments, and the \(386\) admissible conditional pairs per menu gives \(4{,}112\) identified cases and \(8{,}240\) positive rational separator pairs.  Each count is obtained by rational row reduction and the perturbation just displayed, so no floating-point or illegal-profile relaxation enters the regression check.

Legality alone cannot replace source realizability.  For a four-node path of independent pair sources, put mass \(1/8\) on the constant response profiles \((x,a,b,y)\) with \(x,y,a\in\{0,1\}\) and \(b=a\mathbin{\mathsf{xor}}xy\).  Every profile is legal.  Any realization by the path sources would, after conditioning on the middle source, give stochastic local response functions of \(x\) and \(y\).  Extreme-point reduction makes them deterministic functions \(a(x),b(y)\), for which
\[
 (-1)^{a(0)\oplus b(0)}+(-1)^{a(0)\oplus b(1)}+(-1)^{a(1)\oplus b(0)}-(-1)^{a(1)\oplus b(1)}\le2;
\]
indeed the product of the four signs is \(-1\), so either one or three summands are negative.  Convex averaging preserves the bound.  The displayed eight-atom law has the four signed correlations \((1,1,1,-1)\) and value \(4\), so it is not source-realizable.  This exact witness rules out unrestricted legal-table gluing but does not settle the source-aware terminal.

What remains unproved is the algebraic descent: constancy on the positive real fibers of a union of legal product-simplex faces has not been shown to imply membership of \(H/K\) in one rational function field \(\mathbb Q(p)\), nor have component representatives been patched with a divisor nonzero on the entire positive feasible image.  On the negative side, a local algebraic separator satisfying the stored primitive-event equalities has not been shown, for every recursion state, to admit a boundary assignment with nonzero exterior transmission.  These are exactly the two missing implications in the question.
